Master Plan Delays in Indian Cities Raise Concerns Over Urban Development

Two major Indian cities, Indore and Chandigarh, are facing significant delays in finalizing their master plans. Indore's plan has been pending for five years, leading to disorganized growth and illegal settlements, while Chandigarh's 2031 plan is undergoing its final hearing. These delays highlight challenges in urban planning and development across the country.
